responsibility: Implements conversion of an analyzer program_state into an XML “state-diagram” document for human-oriented debugging and diagnostics. This file walks the region_model store, stack frames, regions, bindings, and checker state maps in extrinsic_state, builds a hierarchical XML representation of memory spaces and subregions, infers display types for otherwise untyped heap regions, serializes many svalue kinds into explicit XML nodes, and adds state-machine-specific annotations via add_state_to_xml hooks; it also provides the program_state dump_xml/make_xml entry points that emit this diagnostic-state view to pretty-printers or files.
same_name_distinction: Defines the implementation of the ana-state-to-diagnostic-state facility: it constructs the XML document, traverses regions, bindings, and svalues, and provides program_state::make_xml and dump_xml entry points. In contrast, the same-stem header only declares xml_state and its helper APIs/data members.
